clue.text: I start to help war veteran to swim, and provoke an emotional response

indicators.note: the start of the word help is its opening letter only
letters set to swim drift about and land in a new order

explanation.surface: An old soldier is helped into the water and the scene stirs strong feelings.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to swim' shuffles I and WAR VETERAN into ITARAWNERVE, placed after the start of 'help'.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means touching a sensitive spot so that someone reacts with feeling.

clue.text: TV programme about flying sausage shown before noon

indicators.note: a letter that has gone flying has left the word, so it is dropped

parts.note: chorizo is a spicy Spanish pork sausage
C stands for circa, Latin for about

explanation.surface: A TV show features a sausage soaring through the air just before midday.
explanation.walkthrough: 'flying' takes C (circa, 'about') out of CHORIZO; 'shown before' places the remainder ahead of N. The programme is the long-running BBC science documentary series.
explanation.definitionFit: It is the title of a long-running BBC science documentary strand.

clue.text: Spill valve discovered in this place

parts.note: a tap is a valve controlling flow

indicators.note: dis-covered: its cover, the outside letters, is taken off

parts.note: here means in this place

explanation.surface: A leaking valve has been found right here.
explanation.walkthrough: 'discovered' strips the outer letters from HERE, leaving ER. 'Spill' is the noun: a thin strip of wood or paper for lighting a fire.
explanation.definitionFit: Both are slender sticks or strips used to carry a flame to a candle or fire.

clue.text: New version of left-wing coup?

parts.note: red is the colour of the political left
a coup is a bold stroke, an action

explanation.surface: A question about whether a radical takeover counts as a fresh start.
explanation.walkthrough: Read the answer as two words and it describes a left-wing coup.
explanation.definitionFit: An edited text prepared for publication is a revised form of the original.

clue.text: Wife in thong

parts.note: in means fashionable, as is hip

explanation.surface: A wife is wearing skimpy underwear.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in' looks like a placing instruction but is a synonym for trendy. A thong is also a leather lash.
explanation.definitionFit: A thong is a strip of leather, and a lash made of one is used to strike animals.

clue.text: Choose dodgy gold alloy

parts.note: to elect is to choose
rum is an old British word for odd or suspicious

explanation.surface: Pick a suspect mixture of gold.
explanation.definitionFit: It is a natural pale yellow blend of gold with silver, used for early coins.

clue.text: 5 Gaelic lines of poetry

parts.note: V is the Roman numeral for five
Erse is the Gaelic language of Ireland or Scotland

explanation.surface: Five lines of Gaelic poetry.
explanation.definitionFit: Poetry is written in metrical lines, and a group of them is a stanza.

clue.text: Foolish duchess picked up mineral

indicators.note: picked up as on a radio or by the ear, so the words are heard

parts.note: foolish is silly, and Kate is the Duchess of Cambridge, Catherine Middleton

explanation.surface: A silly aristocrat collected a mineral specimen.
explanation.walkthrough: 'picked up' looks like the duchess gathering the mineral, but it signals that SILLY KATE is said aloud.
explanation.definitionFit: Silicates, compounds of silicon and oxygen, make up most rock-forming minerals.

clue.text: Both sides dismissed in void court case in Balkan region

indicators.note: the two outside letters of the word are thrown out

parts.note: a mistrial is a trial declared void

explanation.surface: In a Balkan area a trial collapses and both parties are sent away.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Both sides dismissed' sounds like the litigants leaving court, but it takes the end letters off MISTRIAL.
explanation.definitionFit: It is the peninsula at the head of the Adriatic, shared by Croatia and Slovenia.

clue.text: Isolated nurses returning, provided preparation to prevent infestation carried out quickly

indicators.note: to nurse is to hold close, so one word cradles the others

parts.note: isolated cases are rare ones

indicators.note: returning means the words are read backwards

parts.note: if means provided
a dip is a chemical bath for sheep against parasites

explanation.surface: Remote nurses come back with a treatment against lice, applied in a hurry.
explanation.walkthrough: 'returning' gives PIDFI, which 'nurses' cradles. 'Nurses' looks like hospital staff but is a verb; a sheep dip is a bath against parasites.
explanation.definitionFit: Rapid-fire describes things done in very quick succession, like rounds from a gun.

clue.text: Complains bitterly as Republican is sick

parts.note: ails means is ill

explanation.surface: A Republican grumbles that he is unwell.
explanation.definitionFit: To rail against something is to protest about it angrily.

clue.text: Essentially gazump wealthy financial centre

indicators.note: the essence of a word is its core, its central letters

parts.note: rich means wealthy

explanation.surface: Outbidding at the last minute is central to how a rich banking hub works.
explanation.walkthrough: To gazump is a British term for raising the price on a house buyer after agreeing a sale.
explanation.definitionFit: The Swiss city is a major banking hub, home of the gnomes of finance.

clue.text: More determined European takes husband's place in Elizabeth Castle's Jersey Shore home

indicators.note: taking a letter's place swaps the new letter in for it
with takes, says one letter stands where another was

parts.note: Elizabeth Castle stands in the bay off St Helier, the capital of Jersey
H is the abbreviation for husband

explanation.surface: A tenacious European moves into a home on the Jersey Shore, the US reality show's setting.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Jersey Shore' looks like the New Jersey TV show, but it is the island of Jersey's coast, where Elizabeth Castle guards ST HELIER; E replaces H.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone with a steely resolve is firm and unbending, so steelier is more resolute.

clue.text: Head kissing has no boundaries

indicators.note: the outer letters, the word's boundaries, are removed

parts.note: snogging is British slang for kissing passionately

explanation.surface: A claim that kissing knows no limits.
explanation.walkthrough: Snogging is British slang for a long kiss.
explanation.definitionFit: Noggin is informal slang for the skull or brain.

clue.text: Lineker accepts defeat describing list of technical terms

indicators.note: accepting something means taking it in, so one word holds the other

parts.note: Gary Lineker is the former England footballer and TV presenter
a loss is a defeat

explanation.surface: The football presenter concedes a defeat while explaining jargon.
explanation.walkthrough: Gary Lineker is a former England striker who presented the BBC's Match of the Day.
explanation.definitionFit: It is an alphabetical appendix explaining specialist vocabulary.

clue.text: Swede's routine appropriate for adoption by wannabe teetotallers

parts.note: a rut is a dull routine

indicators.note: adopted by means taken in by, so one piece goes inside the other

parts.note: AA is Alcoholics Anonymous, for those trying to give up drink
to bag is to appropriate or seize

explanation.surface: A Swedish person's habit suits those trying to quit drinking.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Swede' looks like a person from Sweden but is the vegetable; the 's stands for is. A swede is the British name for the root vegetable.
explanation.definitionFit: The yellow root vegetable called swede in Britain is known by this name in North America.

clue.text: Instrument panel damaged by bit of butter

indicators.note: a damaged word has its letters knocked into disorder

parts.note: a butter is an animal that butts, such as a goat, and its horn is the bit it butts with

explanation.surface: An instrument panel has been harmed by a fragment of butter.
explanation.walkthrough: 'damaged' rearranges PANEL into ALPEN. 'butter' is one who butts, not the dairy spread.
explanation.definitionFit: It is the long wooden horn played by herders in the Alps.

clue.text: Dancer, possibly, almost certainly stops concerning Rambert's principal

indicators.note: something that stops a gap fills it, so it goes between the other letters

parts.note: re means concerning

indicators.note: the principal letter is the leading one
almost means the word stops one letter short

parts.note: indeed means certainly

explanation.surface: A sentence about whether a ballet company's lead performer is nearly sure to halt.
explanation.walkthrough: 'almost' trims the word for certainly; 'stops' plugs the gap in the outer pair. Dancer is one of Santa's sleigh team; Rambert is a British dance company.
explanation.definitionFit: Dancer is named among the deer pulling Santa's sleigh, an example flagged by possibly.

clue.text: In a little while, policeman will accept Penny not thinking for herself

indicators.note: accepting means taking in, so one word holds the letter

parts.note: soon means in a little while
a fed is an American federal agent

explanation.surface: Soon an officer will take Penny into custody, she being unable to think independently.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Penny' looks like a woman's name, but it is the coin.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone given everything ready-made is passive, never having to work things out.

clue.text: Small group of married couples with time for midnight rendezvous

parts.note: ABBA, the Swedish pop group, was two married couples

explanation.surface: A small set of husbands and wives arrange a meeting at midnight.
explanation.definitionFit: It is a witches' assembly, traditionally held at midnight.

clue.text: Excited to furtively look over maintenance expenses

parts.note: up means excited, as in worked up

indicators.note: over means turned over, so the word is read backwards

parts.note: to peek is to look furtively

explanation.surface: Someone keen to sneak a look over the running costs.
explanation.walkthrough: 'over' looks like looking over the costs, but it reverses PEEK.
explanation.definitionFit: Upkeep is the cost of keeping something in good repair.

clue.text: Son of God is intrinsically American

parts.note: per se is Latin for in itself, intrinsically
US means American

explanation.surface: A claim that the Son of God is American by nature.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Son of God' suggests Christ, but here the god is Zeus, father of this Greek hero.
explanation.definitionFit: The Gorgon-slaying Greek hero was fathered by Zeus on Danae.

clue.text: Man beset with problems in a low place

indicators.note: letters with problems are in disorder and need sorting

explanation.surface: A troubled man is at a low point.
explanation.walkthrough: 'a low place' reads like being down in spirits, but it is literal.
explanation.definitionFit: The storey below ground level of a building is its lowest room.

clue.text: Wild fellow in charge

parts.note: a fellow is a man

explanation.surface: An untamed man is the one in command.
explanation.definitionFit: Manic means frenzied, behaving with uncontrolled excitement.

clue.text: Head away from carnival? Just the opposite

indicators.note: the head of the word, its first letter, is taken away

parts.note: a funfair is a carnival

explanation.surface: A fairground boss leaves the carnival, or the other way round.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Just the opposite' reads like a link phrase reversing the instruction, but it is the definition: the opposite of just.
explanation.definitionFit: Being unjust is the reverse of fair-minded.

clue.text: Critical to take steps about university strike, finally

indicators.note: about means around, so one word goes round the letter

parts.note: to act is to take steps

indicators.note: finally picks the last letter of the word

explanation.surface: It is vital to act over the university strike at last.
explanation.definitionFit: A critical situation is a severe, urgent one, as with an acute shortage.

clue.text: Fiddle about during kinky sex

indicators.note: during means inside, so the letters sit within

parts.note: S and M, sadomasochism, is kinky sex
ca is short for circa, about

explanation.surface: Messing about while engaged in unusual bedroom activity.
explanation.definitionFit: A fiddle is a swindle or dishonest trick.

clue.text: Adult liable to finish early, overall

indicators.note: finishing early means the word stops before its last letter

parts.note: prone means liable or inclined

explanation.surface: A grown-up likely to leave work early, all things considered.
explanation.walkthrough: 'overall' looks like an adverb meaning on the whole, but it is the protective garment.
explanation.definitionFit: It is a protective garment worn over clothes, such as a kitchen pinafore.

clue.text: Curse lone working in yard

indicators.note: letters working are on the move into a new order

explanation.surface: Swearing alone while at work in the yard.
explanation.definitionFit: A yard is an enclosed area of ground beside a building.

clue.text: People spreading worrying rumours 50% of American Congress is corrupt

indicators.note: something corrupt is spoiled or broken, so the letters are jumbled
fifty per cent is half, so the first half of the word

explanation.surface: Alarmists claim that half of the US Congress is crooked.
explanation.walkthrough: '50% of' takes AMER from American; 'is corrupt' shuffles it with CONGRESS.
explanation.definitionFit: Alarmists stir public fear by circulating frightening stories.
